description: This file implements CCSP message bus APIs for data model access, including functions for parameter get/set, object addition/deletion, and instance management, with external dependencies on CCSP base API and message bus libraries.

classes.name: MBusObj_t
classes.description: Structure representing a message bus object with configuration and internal handle.

methods.name: TypeTrans
methods.description: Converts internal MBus parameter type to external dataType_e.

methods.name: MBus_Process
methods.description: Core function handling various message bus commands such as get/set parameter, add/delete object, and commit.

methods.name: MBus_Create
methods.description: Creates and initializes an MBusObj_t instance with subsystem, config file, component IDs.

methods.name: MBus_Destroy
methods.description: Releases resources associated with an MBusObj_t instance.

methods.name: MBus_GetParamVal
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a parameter from the message bus.

methods.name: MBus_SetParamVal
methods.description: Sets the value of a parameter on the message bus.

methods.name: MBus_SetParamVect
methods.description: Sets multiple parameters for a given object.

methods.name: MBus_GetParamVect
methods.description: Placeholder for bulk get parameters, not implemented.

methods.name: FindFirstInstance
methods.description: Finds the first instance of an object.

methods.name: GetParamValueForIns
methods.description: Retrieves parameter value for a specific object instance.
